findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning `true` unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging another tenant. This bypasses the previous tenant-boundary check and creates a direct cross-tenant data-access vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so the two tenant parameters no longer constrain reads and the participant's trusted-administrator assertion is not encoded or enforced by the function contract.
